verdict.rationale: Mercury documents debit and credit cards on accounts (mercury-docs-1, mercury-docs-27) and team expense control through cards, limits, approvals and granular user permissions (mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-38). That supports issuing cards to employees under defined permissions, but every explicit issuance claim, including the Cards API, refers only to virtual cards. missing for 10: explicit evidence of physical card issuance, documentation of role definitions tied to individual cardholders, and independent corroboration of employee physical-card workflows.
